source: reference-uni-oc4 (parity with completed UniCredit Woo/PS8/PS9/OC4 convention)

key_sources.smartucf_passphrase: local secrets/smartucf-key.php only; never CP, never settings, never env, never request

oc3_path_translation.rule: Keep the same relative filenames and secret format as OC4. Resolve the directory from a module root helper.
oc3_path_translation.deferred_runtime: Final physical protected root, ownership and permissions on the deployment host. Does not block Phase 1.
